in_sanskrit.name: शोर्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शक्तिः (shaktiḥ) - power, ability; बल: (balam) - strength. So Shorya in Sanskrit means 'Powerful, Strong'.

in_hindi.name: शोर्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: शक्ति (shakti) - power, ability; बल (bal) - strength. So Shorya in Hindi also means 'Powerful, Strong'.

in_tamil.name: சோர்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: பவன் (pavaṉ) - lord, master; அருகியல் (arugiyal) - powerful, strong. So Shorya in Tamil means 'Lord of Power, Master of Strength'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shorya is derived from a Sanskrit word "Shori", meaning victory. In Hindu culture, gods and goddesses associated with the concept of victory are revered and worshipped. Battle victories were not only important for expansion and protection of territory but also upheld the honor and dignity of the people. In this context, the name Shorya bestows blessings of success and victory in all life endeavors.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shorya carries deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the triumph of good over evil, light over darkness, and yearning for inner peace and contentment. It is a reminder that no matter how challenging life may be, one can always strive for and attain spiritual victory and inner peace. Thus, the name Shorya serves as an inspiring and empowering reminder of the power of the human spirit to overcome hardships and achieve success and enlightenment.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Devi Shorya in Kathmandu, Nepal attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Shorya, which means "God of Victory". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shorya signifies the triumph over inner fears and doubts, symbolizing the indomitable spirit that rises above adversity. It reflects the strength and courage within, inspiring one to face challenges with determination and faith.
